completenessClassDefinition: partial-row-extraction means at least one medication is still unconfirmed in the static baseline.

baselines.scope: Horizon BCBSNJ 2026 New Jersey 3-tier Marketplace formulary baseline
baselines.absenceQualification: Only after exact product matching against the complete current formulary; absence is not a denial or eligibility determination.

baselines.scope: Horizon BCBSNJ July 2026 Classic Formulary for plans whose pharmacy benefit is explicitly Horizon Classic
baselines.absenceQualification: The public Classic guide is a baseline only; coverage, exclusions, and benefit design can vary. Direct Access alone does not identify this pharmacy formulary.

baselines.scope: UnitedHealthcare May 2026 commercial PDL baseline; employer benefits can differ
baselines.absenceQualification: Employer and pharmacy-benefit variants must be identified before absence is interpreted.

baselines.scope: Oxford Freedom Network commercial baseline using the linked UHC commercial PDL
baselines.absenceQualification: The exact Oxford product and drug-list variant must be identified first.

baselines.refreshCadence: monthly CMS refresh plus payer document check
baselines.absenceQualification: Only for a plan confirmed to use this exact formulary family; use exact CMS plan data when available.

baselines.scope: AmeriHealth NJ 2026 Individual and Family formulary baseline
baselines.absenceQualification: Only after confirming the member uses the Individual and Family formulary rather than Value or Select.

baselines.scope: AmeriHealth New Jersey Value Formulary effective July 1, 2026
baselines.absenceQualification: Only after confirming the member's pharmacy benefit explicitly uses the New Jersey Value Formulary. Group benefit design can still vary.

baselines.scope: AmeriHealth New Jersey Select Formulary effective July 1, 2026
baselines.absenceQualification: Only after confirming the member's pharmacy benefit explicitly uses the New Jersey Select Formulary. Group benefit design can still vary.

baselines.scope: Cigna National Preferred 3-tier employer formulary abridged baseline
baselines.absenceQualification: The source is abridged and employer drug-list variants can differ.

baselines.scope: Oscar 2026 New Jersey Individual standard formulary route
baselines.absenceQualification: Only after confirming the exact policy and current formulary document.

baselines.scope: Wellcare New Jersey Medicare H0913-002 and H0913-021 source route
baselines.refreshCadence: monthly CMS refresh plus payer document check
baselines.absenceQualification: This is a pharmacy document route, not one immutable comprehensive formulary file; use exact CMS plan data.

baselines.scope: Humana 2026 New Jersey Medicare formulary 26408 baseline
baselines.refreshCadence: monthly CMS refresh plus payer document check
baselines.absenceQualification: Only after exact plan and formulary confirmation; Part B versus Part D rules can still apply.

baselines.scope: Braven Health New Jersey Medicare H0885 plan-document route
baselines.refreshCadence: monthly CMS refresh plus payer document check
baselines.absenceQualification: The linked directory is a plan-document route; use exact CMS plan and formulary data.

baselines.scope: HealthSpring 2026 Medicare Advantage formulary baseline for H3949-054 and H7849-149
baselines.refreshCadence: monthly CMS refresh plus payer document check
baselines.absenceQualification: Only after the exact plan and current formulary are confirmed.

baselines.scope: Clover Health New Jersey 2026 five-tier Medicare formulary 00026082
baselines.refreshCadence: monthly CMS refresh plus payer document check
baselines.absenceQualification: Only after exact plan and product matching; Part B versus Part D rules can still apply.

baselines.scope: Wellpoint New Jersey FamilyCare machine-readable formulary effective August 1, 2026
baselines.refreshCadence: source refresh plus monthly payer-document check
baselines.absenceQualification: The feed is complete for its published product rows, but confirm the member's exact NJ FamilyCare benefit, product, restrictions, and current PDL before treating absence as noncoverage.
